system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

I don't remember my email, but my name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122. Can you help me with this?

Is there anything else you need from me to check my t-shirt orders or the options available? I’d appreciate an update when you can.

Just checking in again—can you confirm how many t-shirt options are currently available in your online store? And let me know if you need anything else to update my pending small t-shirt orders to purple, v-neck, polyester. Thanks.

Thanks for your help. I’d really like to know the exact number of t-shirt options you have right now, just to be clear. And please update all my pending small t-shirt orders to purple, v-neck, polyester. If you need anything else from me, let me know. I don’t remember my email, but my name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122.

Hello, just following up—can you tell me how many t-shirt options are available in your online store right now? And please update my pending small t-shirt orders to purple, v-neck, polyester. If you need more info, let me know.

And please make sure all my pending small t-shirts are changed to purple, v-neck, polyester. My name is Yusuf Rossi, zip code 19122. Thanks.
